❗️⚠️🇮🇩 - URGENT: 7.8-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Indonesia

A powerful 7.8-magnitude earthquake has struck off the coast of Indonesia, according to initial reports.

The Tsunami Warning Center has issued an alert indicating that tsunami waves are possible along coastal areas of Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. 

Residents in low-lying coastal zones are advised to move to higher ground and stay informed through official local authorities.

Official monitoring agencies, including the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center, have confirmed the event in the Molucca Sea region. 

While no tsunami is expected to affect distant U.S. or Canadian coasts, people in coastal areas of Indonesia and nearby countries should stay alert and follow guidance from local authorities such as Indonesia’s BMKG for any region-specific advisories. Indonesia sits on the Ring of Fire, so moderate aftershocks are possible.  

Stay safe, avoid unnecessary coastal travel, and rely only on official sources for the most current information.
